correctness.rationale: Each AP-compatible doxastic incoming column on the fixed chain is exactly an initial segment, giving an explicit bijection with cutoff vectors. Basicity reduces to nonemptiness because chains provide max(s,v); visionaryness reduces to seriality under AP-compatibility; and seriality plus doxasticity is equivalent to the top loop, which forces the full top column. The resulting counts are exact and independently exhaustively checked for n<=4.
